headline: Beganovic becomes Ferrari development and reserve driver for 2027
body: Dino Beganovic will graduate from the Ferrari Driver Academy to become a development and reserve driver for the Formula 1 team in 2027. His role includes being ready to stand in for either race driver when needed.

headline: Lawson headlines a live music set in Austin
body: Liam Lawson & Friends will headline VCARB Garage Sessions at Inn Cahoots in Austin on 22 October. The music programme runs from 7pm to 9:15pm as part of Esses Bazaar ATX ahead of the United States Grand Prix.
